candidateAudit.text: 💭 While most people today know about the influence of London, Paris, and New York on modern thought, Vienna makes few appearances in people’s discussions. However, Vienna, and such individuals as Sigmund Freud and Robert Musil, had a profound impact on modern thinking. The intellectual scene in Vienna, the capital of the Habsburg Empire in Central Europe, in the later part of the 19th century and the earlier half of the 20th century was influenced by the acceptance of modern sciences and the reception of philosophical irrationalism. The tradition of philosophical irrationalism that developed in the Habsburg and German lands is influenced by the diverse cultural and linguistic identities of these regions. Historiography of this region has time and again hit against the problem of writing about the intellectual tradition of a region whose territorial boundaries changed vastly over time. But historians have found ways to contend with this problem. The historian Karl Dietrich Erdmann, in his book Die Spur Österreichs in der deutschen Geschichte: drei Staaten, zwei Nationen, ein Volk?, for instance, argues that the political division and re-division of the German lands did not eradicate intellectual and cultural continuities of the people living within its territories. Ideas were transmitted within a common cultural framework rather than across borders that were remapped several times. candidateAudit.title: OTD in Music History: Historically important American composer Charles Tomlinson Griffes (1884 - 1920) is born Elmira, New York. After receiving childhood piano lessons, in 1903 Gr
candidateAudit.text: OTD in Music History: Historically important American composer Charles Tomlinson Griffes (1884 - 1920) is born Elmira, New York. After receiving childhood piano lessons, in 1903 Griffes traveled to Berlin to study composition with Englebert Humperdinck (1854 - 1921) -- best remembered today as the composer of the enduringly popular fairytale opera "Hansel und Gretel" (1893). Following his return to America in 1907, however, Griffes increasingly began to draw his inspiration from more avant garde figures like Claude Debussy (1862 - 1918), Maurice Ravel (1875 - 1937), and Alexander Scriabin (1872 - 1915). Ironically, Griffes pursued this daring new path while teaching music at a rural boys’ school in New York -- a day job that (perhaps not surprisingly) he found to be "very grim and stifling," although it did provide him with some financial stability. It was against this decidedly mundane backdrop that Griffes began to produce works of remarkable color and imagination, often featuring an "orientalist" tinge. His most enduringly beloved compositions include "The White Peacock" (1915), "The Pleasure Dome of Kubla Khan" (1916), and his Piano Sonata (1919). Tragically, Griffes' life was cut short by the worldwide influenza pandemic in 1920, just as he was truly coming into his own as a distinct artistic figure. candidateAudit.text: 😮What if I told you we found a brewery inside a 300-year-old former convent/monastery complex in Vienna? 🍺🇦🇹 Just a short walk from Belvedere Palace, salmbraeu.vienna sits within the historic Salesian convent complex dating back to 1717 — and one of its dining halls was even once used as a stable for the Empress’s carriage horses. Today, it’s a popular brewery restaurant where beer is brewed in-house and served alongside hearty Austrian classics. 🍻 We came for the history, stayed for the freshly brewed beer and food; and if you’re visiting during the warmer months, the beer garden is definitely where you’ll want to be. 🌿 📍 Salm Bräu, Vienna 🍺 In-house brewed beer 🇦🇹 Traditional Austrian food 🌿 Beer garden especially lovely in summer 🏛️ Near Belvedere Palace so visit this spot after your lunch! 💯SAVE this for your Vienna itinerary & follow me for more heritage travel and food! #Vienna #ViennaFood #AustriaTravel #HeritageTravel #salmbraeu

candidateAudit.text: The Orange Tree Resilience Series I’ve been spending time in Vienna for an artist in residence program, and I was struck by how many parks and how many giant trees are seen in this big city. One tree caught my eye. It was full of large orange blooms. I looked it up online to see what kind of a tree it was .. only to find it shouldn’t be surviving here … that it’s native to Madagascar. It must be resilient. I love resilience because all of us have been knocked down in life, but when you stand up again and dust yourself off, it’s an empowering feeling. This painting is nothing like the actual tree. It’s more of a celebration of the fact that it caught my eye and captured my attention. #viennaart #abstract #viennaevents vienna #viennatoday “Resilience” Soon Gallery 3 Bauerlegasse Wien Today 16:00 - 20:00 Open to the public Admission is free

candidateAudit.text: Wondering what you’ll be doing October 24th? 🍂 Picture this… It’s dark outside, the kind of crisp autumn evening where you actually want to be tucked inside somewhere warm. You walk into nujustudios and it’s all candlelight, soft music and the soothing smell of pine in the air. You take your shoes off, pull on your fluffiest socks and let the outside world stay at the door for a little while. We’ll start with a slow, gentle yoga flow - nothing to achieve, nowhere to get to. Just moving, stretching and breathing our way out of the day. Then we’ll settle in, wrapped up and cosy, while the sounds of sound healing wash over you. A little grounding breathwork will help you soften even further before we take you into Yoga Nidra - that delicious in-between space where you’re not quite asleep, not quite awake, and your only job is to completely let go. And when you slowly come back, there’ll be a warm cup of tea waiting for you. No rushing. No checking the time. Just candles flickering, cosy blankets, sleepy eyes and a little moment to simply be. Before you head home, we’ll send you off with a little goodie bag too - because who doesn’t love a tiny autumn surprise? 🤎 So if your body has been quietly asking for a pause lately… maybe this is your sign. Join us for Slow Autumn Evening hosted by Monique experiencetheun + Ricarda every.bodyyoga at the beautiful nujustudios 24 October · 16:30 - 19:30 Yoga · Sound Healing · Breathwork · Yoga Nidra · Tea · Goodie Bag Come in from the cold. Stay for a while. Leave feeling a little softer than when you arrived. 🍂 #viennaevents #autumnvien

candidateAudit.title: 🚀 Das epische Ozzfest‑Night‑Showdown mit The Masked Singer! In einer dunklen, mit Neonlicht durchfluteten Bühne, die an die legendären Metal‑Konzerte der 80er erinnert, treten die
candidateAudit.text: 🚀 Das epische Ozzfest‑Night‑Showdown mit The Masked Singer! In einer dunklen, mit Neonlicht durchfluteten Bühne, die an die legendären Metal‑Konzerte der 80er erinnert, treten die maskierten Stars in atemberaubenden Kostümen auf, während ein Live‑Orchester aus Gitarren, Bass und donnernden Schlagzeugen den Rhythmus liefert, der das Publikum in Ekstase versetzt. Jeder Auftritt wird von spektakulären Lichtinstallationen begleitet, die im Takt der Musik pulsieren und die Gesichter der Sänger hinter ihren Masken noch mysteriöser erscheinen lassen, während das Publikum jede Note wie ein Donnerhall in den Ohren spürt. Die Show verbindet die rohe Energie von Ozzfest mit dem geheimnisvollen Charme von The Masked Singer, indem sie ikonische Songs von Ozzy Osbourne neu interpretiert und dabei überraschende Gesangs- und Tanzperformance‑Elemente einbaut, die selbst eingefleischte Fans verblüffen. Hinter den Kulissen haben die Produzenten ein geheimes Voting‑System installiert, das den Zuschauern in Österreich ermöglicht, live per App zu entscheiden, welcher Maskierte den ultimativen Metal‑Crossover-Preis gewinnt, was für eine nie dagewesene Interaktivität sorgt. Verpasst nicht das einzige Mal, dass sich diese beiden Welten zu einem unvergesslichen Spektakel verschmelzen – ein Abend voller Überraschungen, Adrenalin und musikalischer Magie, der euch noch lange nach dem Abspann im Kopf bleiben wird. Ist Ozzfest‑Night mit The Masked Singer das beste Musik‑Crossover des Jahres, oder bleibt das klassische Rock‑Festival das wahre Highlight? #OzzfestNight #TheMaskedSinger #MetalCrossover #Liv

candidateAudit.text: 🇺🇦 Мода не моя професія, але я люблю красиві образи, деталі та атмосферу fashion. Цими днями у Відні проходить Fashion Week, і я вирішила сама зануритися в цю атмосферу. Стильні люди, цікаві образи, музика та багато творчості навколо. На сайті можна знайти fashion events, pop-up stores та покази. Квитки коштують від €29, покази триватимуть до 19 вересня. Для мене це про натхнення, нові враження та просто красивий вечір. 🇬🇧 Fashion is not my profession, but I love beautiful looks, details and the whole fashion atmosphere. Vienna Fashion Week is taking place these days, and I decided to experience it for myself. Stylish people, interesting looks, music and so much creativity all around. candidateAudit.text: Eine musikalische Zeitreise, die nun endlich auf die Leinwand kommt 🎻 Tauchen Sie ein in die faszinierende Welt von THE KLEZMER PROJECT, das ab sofort in österreichischen Kinos zu sehen ist.
